categories.main_business_segments: Zhengyuan Zhihui Group primarily operates in software and information technology services, focusing on smart campus solutions for higher education and K12 education, smart government and enterprise solutions, cloud services, investment and operation services including self-service laundry and IoT air conditioning leasing, and intelligent manufacturing of smart hardware products. The company provides integrated digital campus platforms, smart logistics, and AI-driven educational services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages IoT, AI, big data, cloud computing, mobile internet, digital twin, and AI large models to develop its smart campus platforms and services. It integrates multiple technology platforms such as IoT middle platform, data middle platform, AI middle platform, payment middle platform, authentication middle platform, and collaboration middle platform. The company also develops and manufactures intelligent hardware including edge computing gateways, smart locks, facial recognition terminals, and energy management devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include educational institutions (universities and K12 schools), government agencies, enterprises, and smart parks. The company serves over 1,400 higher education institutions and has a user base exceeding 50 million cardholders. It also targets sectors such as military, police, power grid, and elderly care, expanding its smart campus and smart park solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with subsidiaries and offices in most provinces except Tibet, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Major revenue contributions come from East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It also has overseas operations, including a subsidiary in Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhengyuan Zhihui operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated software platforms, intelligent hardware products, and comprehensive digital services directly to end customers such as schools and government entities. It also engages in investment and operational services, managing and leasing equipment to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes multi-technology integration innovation, focusing on AI, IoT, big data, cloud computing, and digital twin technologies. It invests heavily in R&D with nearly 900 personnel, developing AI large model platforms for smart campuses, smart dormitories, smart canteens, and integrated educational service platforms. Strategic priorities include digital transformation, AI empowerment, ecosystem collaboration, and expanding ToB to ToC services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through project-based system construction contracts, ongoing operation and maintenance service fees, leasing and rental income from smart hardware (e.g., air conditioning, laundry), and value-added services via cloud platforms. The company uses a direct sales model with some agency and distribution channels, and recognizes revenue based on contract milestones and service delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhengyuan Zhihui is positioned as a leading smart campus service provider in China, with a strong market presence in educational digitalization. It competes with traditional education institutions, technology firms, and internet giants entering the smart education sector. The company leverages its integrated platform capabilities, extensive customer base, and strategic partnerships with major IT and telecom companies to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.19 billion, a slight decline of 2.43% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.99 million, down 71.35%. Total assets reached RMB 2.86 billion with a stable growth trend. Despite short-term profit pressure due to tightened funding in education informatization, the company maintains positive cash flow and continues to invest heavily in R&D (over RMB 194 million in 2024).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhengyuan Zhihui offers a comprehensive, multi-technology integrated smart campus ecosystem that combines digital infrastructure with AI-driven personalized services. Its unique value lies in the fusion of IoT, AI, big data, and cloud platforms to deliver seamless, intelligent educational and operational experiences. The company’s proprietary AI large model platform, extensive hardware portfolio, and strong ecosystem collaborations differentiate it by providing scalable, customizable, and efficient digital transformation solutions for education and government sectors.
